_meta.status: ZAPOJENO do llm/index.html (DATA:SCORING marker, render_scoring v build.py). v0.2.0 kalibrace 2026-06-20: scoreWeights price 0.45->0.32, frontier 0.10->0.18, feature 0.45->0.50; roleWeights frontier zvysen u agents (0.20->0.35), coding (0.30->0.40), reasoning (0.40->0.50), rag (0.10->0.15) => capability-heavy role vedou k frontier modelum, chatbot/rag/classification zustavaji cenove vedene. Vahy jsou EDITORIAL (live-tunable: edit + python build.py). modelScores nize jsou referencni DRAFT - build.py je dopocitava z models.json (render_scoring/_model_dims), nepouzivaji se primo.
_meta.note: Navrh skorovaciho modelu LLM recommendation enginu (ekvivalent automation/data/scoring-model.json). Doporuceni = pro vybrany use-case (role) najdi nejlepe sedici model. matchScore(model) = featureScore*scoreWeights.feature + priceScore*scoreWeights.price + frontierScore*scoreWeights.frontier. featureScore = roleWeights[role] . modelScore[dimensions] (skalarni soucin pres dimenze, BEZ price — cenu resi samostatny priceScore z enginu, stejne jako automation lowPrice). priceScore se POCITA ZA BEHU z enginu (canonical_monthly 'mo' / cost(m) na aktualnim profilu uzivatele), NENI v tomto souboru — soubor drzi jen VAHY a OVERITELNA per-tier/per-model skore. ZDROJ PRAVDY pro vahy je tento soubor; index.html by ho cetl pres marker /* DATA:SCORING:START|END */ generovany llm/build.py (zatim NEEXISTUJE marker ani render_scoring v llm/build.py — soucast wiringu).
_meta.scale: Vsechny vahy a skore 0..1. roleWeights[role] davaji soucet ~1 pres skorovaci dimenze. lowPrice je REZERVOVANY (cenu resi priceScore z enginu, nepouziva se ve featureScore) — drzime ho jako vahu pro citelnost role profilu, presne jako automation.

dimension_definitions.context: Velikost context okna. Skore odvozeno z contextWindow (norm. log skalou: 200k~0.6, 256k~0.65, 400k~0.8, 1M~1.0). Overitelne z models.json.
dimension_definitions.caching: Ekonomika promtp cachingu = jak levne je cached input vuci plnemu inputu (1 - cachedInputPerM/inputPerM). Vyssi = vyhodnejsi pro opakovany kontext. Model bez cache ceny (cached=null) = 0. Overitelne z models.json.
dimension_definitions.cheapOutput: Levny output token. Skore = inverzni norm. outputPerM v ramci celeho lineupu (levnejsi output = vyssi skore). Pro role s velkym outputem (agents, reasoning). Overitelne z models.json.
dimension_definitions.batch: Dostupnost batch API slevy. Skore = batchDiscount slevove procento (1 - batchDiscount); batch=null => 0. Pro async/bulk role. Overitelne z models.json.
dimension_definitions.frontier: Schopnostni trida (tier). frontier=1.0, mid=0.6, budget=0.3. EDITORIAL tier z models.json (NE benchmark) — proto je to per-tier, ne vymysleny per-model skill skore.
dimension_definitions.lowPrice: REZERVOVANE. Cenu resi priceScore pocitany z enginu na profilu uzivatele (mo / cost(m)). Drzime vahu pro citelnost, nepouziva se ve featureScore.

chatbot.label: Chatbot / assistant
chatbot.why: Dlouha historie v inputu, kratky output, vysoky cache hit — caching ekonomika a cena rozhoduji.

coding.label: Coding assistant
coding.why: Velky kontext (repo), tool-use, dulezita schopnost (frontier) i delsi kontext.

agents.label: Autonomous agents
agents.why: Mnoho retezenych volani, hodne tokenu in i out, cache na opakovany system/tool kontext.

rag.label: RAG / long-context
rag.why: Retrievany kontext do inputu — velikost okna a cena inputu (cache) dominuji.

classification.label: Bulk / cheap classification
classification.why: Objemove, async — batch sleva a levny output/cena rozhoduji, schopnost min.

reasoning.label: Reasoning-heavy
reasoning.why: Slozite ulohy, dlouhe vystupy — frontier tier a levny output.

tierScores._note: Default per-TIER skore pro dimenze, ktere nejsou odvoditelne per-model z modelScores (jen frontier je ciste tier). Per-model overitelne dimenze (context/caching/cheapOutput/batch) jsou v modelScores nize a maji prednost; tierScores slouzi jako fallback/sanity a pro frontier dimenzi.

frontier_v2._note: Oprava Mistral dominance. 'frontier' (capability) = REALNY Epoch ECI (normalizovany do eci_range pres matchnute modely, z llm/data/benchmarks.json scrapnute scriptem scripts/llm-benchmark-pull.py, CC-BY) KDE JE; jinak EDITORIAL capabilityBand (stejna skala); jinak tier (coverage guard). ECI a bandy sdili jednu skalu (bandy ~ kam padaji srovnatelne realne modely: real 'strong' DeepSeek/Grok ~0.65). Band = REDAKCNI odhad (stejna kategorie jako tier, NE benchmark, NE zobrazene cislo); per-model ho PREBIJI ECI kdyz Epoch model ma. Implementovano v llm/build.py _model_dims.
frontier_v2.price_role_aware: recommend() skaluje globalni price clen vahou role lowPrice (priceW = roleWeights[role].lowPrice / 0.17): capability-heavy role (reasoning/agents/coding) vazi cenu min, chatbot/classification vic — aktivace REZERVOVANEHO lowPrice. Implementovano v recommend() (home-v6.html + llm/calculator.html, parita).

capabilityBand._note: EDITORIAL DRAFT (owner-review). Klic = model id z data/models.json. NE benchmark, NE zobrazene cislo — jen vstup do interniho frontier skore (frontier_v2). Nahradi scraped benchmarky.

modelScores._note: Per-model skore odvozena z data/models.json (verified 2026-06-20). VSE pocitatelne ze ctyr overenych poli (contextWindow, cachedInputPerM/inputPerM, outputPerM, batchDiscount) + tier. Hodnoty zde jsou PREDPOCITANY DRAFT pro review; v cilovem wiringu by je build.py mohl dopocitat z models.json (jeden zdroj pravdy), aby se neduplikovaly. context: log-norm vuci 1M. caching: 1 - cached/input. cheapOutput: 1 - norm(log outputPerM) vuci lineupu (0.28..180). batch: 1 - batchDiscount (null=>0). frontier: z tieru.
